props.gloss_en: the mishna: one who slaughters [one of mother and offspring] for idolatry -- the Sages obligate
the mishna: one who slaughters the red heifer -- R' Shimon exempts
the mishna: the heifer whose neck is to be broken -- R' Shimon exempts
Reish Lakish: they taught [the Sages' liability] only where he slaughtered the first for idolatry and the second for his table
Reish Lakish: but the first for his table and the second for idolatry -- exempt
Reish Lakish: for he is subject to the greater [penalty] than it

R' Yochanan: rather, sometimes even [if] he slaughtered the first for his table and the second for idolatry he is liable -- e.g. where they forewarned him on account of 'it and its offspring' and did not forewarn him on account of idolatry
and Reish Lakish said: since were they to forewarn him he would be exempt, when they do not forewarn him he is also exempt
Reish Lakish's ground: since with a forewarning [for the graver offence] he would be exempt, without one he is exempt too
those liable to death [who acted] unwittingly, and another matter -- R' Yochanan: liable
those liable to death unwittingly, and another matter -- Reish Lakish: exempt
those liable to lashes unwittingly, and another matter -- R' Yochanan: liable
those liable to lashes unwittingly, and another matter -- Reish Lakish: exempt
R' Yochanan [holds] liable, since they did not forewarn him
Reish Lakish [holds] exempt, since were they to forewarn him he would be exempt, so when they do not forewarn him he is also exempt
for had it taught us only this [oto ve'et beno and idolatry], Reish Lakish says it here; but in that [Rav Dimi's case] say he concedes to R' Yochanan
and had it been stated only of that, R' Yochanan says it there; but in this say he concedes to Reish Lakish -- [both] are necessary
the baraita, R' Shimon: the heifer is susceptible to food impurity, since it had a time of fitness
Reish Lakish: R' Shimon would say: the heifer is redeemed upon its pyre
R' Yochanan: the red heifer [clause] is not mishna
the mishna (Sotah): if the killer is found before the heifer's neck is broken, it goes out and grazes in the herd
Reish Lakish in R' Yannai's name: the egla [clause] is not mishna (first tradition)
R' Yannai: I heard a boundary for it [the egla's prohibition], and I forgot
and the colleagues were inclined to say: its descent to the hard valley forbids it
Rav Pinchas son of Rav Ami: we teach it in Reish Lakish's [own] name -- the egla [clause] is not mishna (second tradition)
the leper's birds -- from when are they forbidden? R' Yochanan: from the time of slaughter
and Reish Lakish: from the time of taking
rather, R' Chiyya bar Abba < R' Yochanan: the egla [clause] is not mishna (third tradition)

schemas.gloss_en: גמר 'קיחה' 'קיחה' מעגלה ערופה -- 'taking' (the leper's birds) and 'taking' (the egla): as the egla, so the birds -- forbidden from their taking

supports.gloss_en: ואזדו לטעמייהו, דכי אתא רב דימי אמר... רבי יוחנן אומר: חייב -- R' Yochanan's forewarning ruling follows his ruling in Rav Dimi's case (kind svara: no support kind for לטעמייהו)

objections.gloss_en: ופרת חטאת שחיטה שאינה ראויה היא? והתניא: רבי שמעון אומר: פרה מטמאה טומאת אוכלין הואיל והיתה לה שעת הכושר; ואמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש: אומר היה רבי שמעון, פרה נפדית על גבי מערכתה (= p_para_nifdeit_al_maarachta)

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רב שמן בר אבא אמר רבי יוחנן: פרת חטאת אינה משנה (= p_para_eina_mishna) -- the clause is disowned, not defended

objections.gloss_en: ועגלה ערופה לאו שחיטה ראויה היא? והתנן: נמצא ההורג עד שלא תערף העגלה -- תצא ותרעה בעדר

answered_by.gloss_en: עגלה ערופה אינה משנה -- first said at 82a.2 in R' Yannai's name; the tradition that stands is R' Chiyya bar Abba's in R' Yochanan's (= p_egla_eina_mishna_ry)

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי ינאי הכי? והאמר רבי ינאי: גבול שמעתי בה ושכחתי, ונסבין חבריא לומר ירידתה לנחל איתן אוסרתה; ואם איתא לישני: כאן קודם ירידה, כאן לאחר ירידה (82a.4) -- unanswered: Rav Pinchas replaces the tradition (kind svara under protest: the והאמר gap)

קשיא לן: מי אמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש הכי? והא איתמר: צפורי מצורע מאימתי נאסרין... ריש לקיש אמר משעת לקיחה, ואמרינן מאי טעמא -- גמר קיחה קיחה מעגלה ערופה (= gs_kicha_kicha_egla) -- so for him the egla is forbidden from its taking; unanswered: the stam's אלא (82a.8) replaces the tradition
